name: Anand Rathi Wealth Ltd
title: Anand Rathi Wealth Ltd - 543415 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Wealth manager reports 24% PAT growth (ex-fair-value) to INR116 crores with 1.1 lakh crore AUM, but supply-side levers are absent and about a quarter of the FY27 guidance is a function of mark-to-market gains.

triggers.label: AMC licence application approved by Board
triggers.quote: we have just got a Board consent approval to apply for an AMC license

triggers.label: Equity MF net sales INR1,900 crores in Q1
triggers.quote: we had INR1,900 crores of net sales in equity mutual funds alone

triggers.label: Q1 achieved 24% of FY27 revenue guidance
triggers.quote: we have achieved 24% of full year revenue guidance of INR1,415 crores

triggers.label: Yield pressure from TER pass-through, 2-3 bps
triggers.quote: 1, 2, 3 bps of transmission might happen here or there

guidance.quote: we have achieved 24% of full year revenue guidance of INR1,415 crores
25% of its full year PAT guidance of INR460 crores
So, can you grow this business for 3, 4, 5 years at 20%, 25%? In our judgment, yes
INR 1,100 crores, INR1,200 crores of net sales, which we intend to do per month for the next 3 years

red_flags.label: Revenue and PAT boosted by INR110 crore other income, mostly MTM on ARGFL holding (INR96 crore)
red_flags.quote: INR96 crores that is mark-to-market gain in the holding of Anand Rathi Global Finance Limited

red_flags.label: Related-party structured product concentration on group NBFC
red_flags.quote: In that structured product, we sell Anand Rathi Global Finance structured products and third-party products. The proportion of Anand Rathi is greater

red_flags.label: Heavy reliance on promoter-led narrative; evasions on UK business and AMC economics
red_flags.quote: we don't want that to be completely disclosed today

evasions.topic: Economics of UK business and backward integration rationale
evasions.quote: we don't want that to be completely disclosed today. We have stronger reasons.

evasions.topic: Yields on UK NRI business vs India
evasions.quote: we'd like to be excited after some numbers trickle
